description:
• Brand introduction: 

Elton Pepple is a luxury timepiece brand crafted for style-conscious minimalists. Our mission is to redefine understated elegance with impeccably designed, ultra-slim watches that make a bold statement through simplicity. With a commitment to quality craftsmanship, timeless design, and premium materials, we create watches that seamlessly elevate any wardrobe.


• Product description:

Elton Pepple watches are designed with a distinctive square face, ultra-slim profile, and high-end materials, offering a perfect blend of modern sophistication and classic refinement. Each timepiece is crafted for those who appreciate minimalist aesthetics and premium craftsmanship, making them a versatile accessory for any occasion.

 
• USP (Unique Selling Point):

Ultra-Slim Design: One of the thinnest luxury watches on the market.

• Distinctive Square Face: A signature shape that sets us apart from traditional round watches.

• Minimalist Luxury: Sleek, timeless, and designed for effortless elegance.

• Premium Materials: High-quality craftsmanship using durable and refined components.

• Gift-Ready Presentation: Every watch comes in an elegant, luxury packaging, creating a premium unboxing experience.

 
• Payment terms:

Affiliate commission up to 15% per sale through our program.

• Secure payments through PayPal

Welcome to Elton Pepple! Thanks for joining our Ambassador program.

These following terms and conditions apply to individuals who are accessing or using the Program both as a merchant (“we” or “merchant”) and an affiliate (“you” or “affiliate”) who refers customers to use product or service from the merchant.

By participating in the Program, Affiliate agrees to use the Program in the manner specified in, and are bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety you are not authorized to register as an Affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner.

1. Approve or Reject of the Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject ANY Affiliate Program Registration in our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your Affiliate Program Registration.

2. Affiliate Links and Coupon

Affiliate link is automatically generated, but you can also generate an affiliate link for a specific product or collection. If a person clicks on someone else’s referral link and then later they click on yours, yours is the one that counts.

Affiliate might or might not be assigned to one coupon code with details and usage clarified on Dashboard. If customer both click on the affiliate link and use coupon code, you will not receive a double commission. If you’re not assigned a branded coupon, then you’re not allowed to promote the coupon.

Affiliate may also advertise merchant website on online channels such as Facebook, Instagram,... or offline classified channel ads, magazines, and newspapers.

Affiliate is strictly prohibited from running any paid advertising campaigns, including, but not limited to, search engine marketing (SEM), pay-per-click (PPC), social media ads, or display ads that link directly to the affiliate link. Any breach of this policy may result in the immediate termination of the affiliate's account and forfeiture of any outstanding commissions.

Affiliate is only permitted to promote via approved organic channels and is encouraged to contact us for further clarification on acceptable promotional practices.

Affiliate is strictly prohibited from promoting or associating the item with content that includes excessive nudity, sexually explicit material, promotion of alcohol, drugs, illegal substances, violence, or any content that may be deemed offensive or inappropriate. Violation of these content guidelines may result in immediate termination of the affiliate’s account, forfeiture of outstanding commissions, and potential legal action as necessary.

3. Mandatory Content Requirements 

  1. Tagging Requirement
    Whenever you feature or wear Elton Pepple watches in any of your content, you must tag Elton Pepple’s official account (@eltonpeppleofficial).

  2. Content Commitment
    As an ambassador, you are required to consistently feature the watch in your content across different social media platforms. While your content doesn’t need to be exclusively dedicated to Elton Pepple, you must mention it alongside other brands when relevant. You are expected to wear the watch at least 5 times in your posts within the first 90 days of receiving your watch. Using your unique affiliate link is optional but highly encouraged, as it can significantly boost your commission-based earnings.

  3. Content Publishing Timeline:

As an ambassador, you are required to start publishing content or notify the brand of your content plans within 7 days of receiving the watch. This ensures clear communication and helps maintain alignment with the brand’s expectations for the collaboration.

  1. Hashtag Usage
    In any post where Elton Pepple is tagged (as per Condition 1), you must include the following hashtags:

    • #eltonpepple

    • #eltonpepplewatches

    • #eltonpepplecollab

By signing this agreement, the ambassador acknowledges and agrees to be legally bound to fulfill the content requirements outlined above. Failure to comply may result in termination of the partnership and forfeiture of any associated benefits.

4. Commissions and payment

Refer any customer to make a purchase on our website, you will get a commission amount which is calculated based on Commission structure. Commission amount is dependent on order value and not including extra fee (tax, shipping cost,...).

For an Affiliate to receive a commission, you need to specify the payment details on Settings. Payment schedule will be notified on Affiliate Guide page.

Payments will only be sent for transactions that have been successfully completed. Use of the Affiliate Program is subject to a fair use policy which gives merchant the right to review each and every referral order. Status of commission if displayed in Commission tab, any paid commission will be listed on Payment tab. Transactions that result in charge backs or refunds will not be paid out.

5. Marketing tool

We may share promotion media such as banner, logo or specific collection promotion to you through Marketing tool tab. You can download the media or get the HTML embed code in order to share on affiliate channels.

6 . Network

If Network tab is activated, affiliate can invite others to become their downline affiliate. If any downline affiliate brings order to merchant shop, upline affiliate will also get network commission which depends on merchant settings.

To invite other affiliates into the system, share network link and any other affiliate who click on that link and sign up will become a downline affiliate.

7. Cookie

We use a cookie to track people who have clicked on your link, so they need to be using cookies for us to track them.

If a person doesn't allow cookies or clears their cookies then we can't track them so can't pay earnings on that person's activity.

Cookies day is said on the Affiliate registration form. The tracking day will start from the time a customer clicks on the affiliate’s link or use the coupon. Within the cookie time, every order made by this customer at merchant website will automatically result in commissions to the affiliate (There’s no need for the customer to click on the affiliate link then).

8. Removal from Referral Program

If an affiliate wishes to be removed from the affiliate program, they can do so by contacting: ambassadors@eltonpepple.com

9. Content usage rights

By agreeing to the terms and conditions of the program, the affiliate hereby grants Elton Pepple the worldwide rights in perpetuity to use the online content the affiliate creates about Elton Pepple in original or modified forms. Elton Pepple shall have universal rights to license any and all materials produced under this Agreement, including, without limitation, any of the ideas, images, videos, copyrighted works, announcements, gestures, phrases, or words incorporated therein to be repurposed and syndicated for the Merchant’s own channels.

Go forward and refer!

We're very glad you've made it to the end of this important document.

We wish you all the very best. You can always re-visit these Affiliate Program terms and conditions in the future and if you have any questions you can send email to ambassadors@eltonpepple.com for support.
